title: HOSPES Canonical Pipeline States
description: Canonical state set for AppearanceOpportunity. Every opportunity has exactly one state at any time. Main states form a linear progression through the production lifecycle; branch states are terminal or holding states reachable from multiple points in the main flow. The transitions map lists legal next states from each state — derived conservatively from lifecycle order and the branch rules in transcript §4 and domain_kernel.yaml.

main_states.description: A Person was identified as a potential guest candidate. No research or editorial work has started.
Background research is being conducted on the candidate: public work, prior interviews, editorial fit.
Research complete. The candidate has a proposed episode thesis and passes editorial criteria. Ready for host review.
The opportunity is in the host or producer approval queue. A human is reviewing why_guest, why_now, episode_thesis, and relationship_class.
A human approved this opportunity for outreach. The system may now identify contact routes and draft messages.
The best available contact route has been identified and verified for this opportunity.
The system generated a draft outreach message. Awaiting human review and approval before sending.
A human approved the outreach draft. Ready to send — the human sends it; the system records the action.
First outreach was sent by a human. The system begins tracking for replies and follow-up deadlines.
A follow-up deadline was reached with no reply. A human must decide: send a follow-up draft, pause, or close.
The guest expressed positive interest. Scheduling or negotiation may now begin.
Active negotiation on fees, logistics, travel, topic scope, or format. All negotiation requires human handling — the system does not improvise.
Scheduling dates, times, and studio for the recording.
Recording is confirmed with date, time, and studio assignment.
Guest intake form (logistics preferences, care profile, shipping consent) is awaiting completion.
The pre-interview call between producer and guest is scheduled but not yet completed.
The guest release/consent form is outstanding. Recording may not proceed until signed.
Production prep is active: research brief delivered to host, segment deck finalized, studio logistics confirmed.
All production, technical, and logistics checks have passed. The episode is cleared to record.
The recording session is complete. Raw media is being ingested.
Post-recording follow-up with the guest is due: thank-you note, gift arrangement, promise tracking.
A transcript has been generated and attached to the episode. Content review may begin.
Edited audio/video and derived content units are in human review before publication approval.
Content is approved and scheduled; distribution is queued.
The episode is published to all distribution channels.
Post-publication relationship maintenance. The system tracks nurture cadence and drafts check-ins; a human sends them.

branch_states.description: The guest declined the invitation. Reason is recorded for future re-evaluation. Reachable from OUTREACH_SENT, FOLLOW_UP_DUE, INTERESTED, NEGOTIATING.
Opportunity is on hold at human discretion — timing or capacity issue. May resume from any active state.
Guest or show decided to revisit after a future date. revisit_after date is required. May resume from OUTREACH_SENT, INTERESTED, SCHEDULING.
This record is a duplicate of another AppearanceOpportunity for the same Person + Show. The canonical record is the surviving one.
The guest explicitly opted out of all contact. Terminal state — no automation or human may initiate contact. Equivalent to person.do_not_contact_set on the linked Person.
This opportunity is under legal review and all automated processing is halted. Requires human resolution.
The system escalated this opportunity because it encountered a situation outside its decision scope. A human must review and manually advance or close.
A confirmed booking was cancelled before recording. Distinct from DECLINED (which is pre-booking). Reachable from BOOKED and later states.
